claims.verdict: OWNERSHIP VERIFIED; SIM DISAGREES; DEPENDENCY CONFIRMED IN OUR WORLDS
claims.what_the_data_shows: Egbuka actual FLEX 14.4% (their ~15%: verified). Our P(Egbuka 100+ rec yds) 9.2% vs their 3.5%; driven by our TB pass-volume centre (Daniels 34.6 att vs 27 in his one start; D-02). Inside our worlds, Egbuka DK correlates +0.35 with Daniels attempts; conditional on Daniels <= 27 attempts, P(100+) = 1.6%, close to theirs. First-TD probability is not measurable (no event order in our worlds).

claims.claim: 11 of 150 of their lineups pair Javonte and Goodson: in favourable scripts a backfield shares MORE total carries rather than cannibalising
claims.verdict: NOT SUPPORTED IN AGGREGATE; THE CONDITIONAL VERSION IS UNTESTED
claims.what_the_data_shows: Measured RB1~RB2 same-club DK correlation is 0.00 [-0.04, 0.05]; our worlds give Javonte-Goodson -0.03 (DK) and -0.04 (carries). Script-conditional co-movement has not been measured. In our engine, TD allocation does not follow per-world carries (rush_td_share is fixed, game.py:489-490), so a world with more Goodson carries does not raise his TD chance. That is a modelling simplification.

claims.claim: P(Javonte and Goodson both TD) 13.9% vs a prediction-market 6.8%
claims.what_the_data_shows: Ours 15.0%; theirs 13.9%. The prediction-market price is betting content and is recorded only.

claims.claim: Unknown QB spreads targets (max 6 last week) so cheap receivers are viable; backup QBs may favour secondary receivers they practise with (speculative); Hurst 1 target fewer than Egbuka on ~25 fewer snaps

claims.claim: Most-duped lineup (79 dupes in their projection): Dak, Aubrey, Lamb, Cowboys DST, Daniels, Flournoy, about 50K; most-duped lineups sit at/near the cap and "make sense"
claims.verdict: LINEUP FOUND; LEVEL HIGHER THAN THEIR FORECAST; CAP CLUSTERING VERIFIED
claims.what_the_data_shows: The six-player set {Dak, Aubrey, Lamb, Cowboys DST, Daniels, Flournoy} appears in the 150-max 352 times across captains. With Dak as CPT ($50,000 exactly, the only arrangement at "about 50K"): 295 copies, the 29th most-duplicated lineup. Daniels CPT ($49,100) 36; Aubrey CPT 8; Flournoy CPT 7; Cowboys CPT 6; Lamb CPT would cost $50,700 (illegal). In the 20-max contests the Dak-CPT version had 144 and 124 copies (ranks 7 and 9). Their figure (79) does not name a contest. If it was the 150-max, actual was about 3.7x higher. Cap clustering is verified: the 25 most-duplicated lineups all cost $49,500-$50,000; mean other-copies per entry is 112 at $50,000 and 124 at $49,500-49,900, against 9.8 below $48,000.

claims.claim: To play Tampa you must assume they outperform projection ("mentally boosting")
claims.what_the_data_shows: Manual boosting is not allowed in our system (no silent constants). The legitimate analogue is a declared scenario-conditional portfolio arm frozen before lock.

claims.claim: Sims updated after inactives; in NFL usually nothing further to update
claims.what_the_data_shows: Our OFFICIAL run used the post-inactives roster (inactives received 23:06Z, worlds written 23:08Z, kickoff 00:15Z).
